_doc: GDD 127. The only source of player-facing text. {name} placeholders are filled at runtime from canonical data.

strings.ui_profile_delete_confirm: This cannot be undone. Delete this save?
strings.ui_profile_backup_loaded: The main save was damaged, so the backup was loaded.
strings.ui_quit_confirm: Return to the main menu? Your progress is saved first.
strings.ui_rotate_body: Roti Lezat Tycoon is played in landscape. Turn your phone sideways to continue.
strings.ui_rotate_tap: Auto-rotate turned off? Tap anywhere to switch to landscape.
strings.ui_save_error: Save data could not be loaded.
strings.ui_boot_error: The game data could not be checked. Please reinstall the game.
strings.ui_credits_body:
Roti Lezat Tycoon

Every model, icon, sound and song in this game is generated by code.
Built with Godot Engine (MIT license).

Thank you for playing!
strings.ui_character_note: Your choice changes only how your baker looks.
strings.ui_bakery_name_invalid: Please use 1 to 24 characters, without line breaks.
strings.ui_feedback_no_free_mixer: No free Mixer can make this recipe
strings.ui_feedback_no_free_oven: No free Oven can bake this dough
strings.ui_feedback_needs_equipment: Needs Mixer T{mixer} and Oven T{oven}
strings.ui_feedback_command_queue_full: Your baker already has three tasks
strings.ui_feedback_nothing_to_do: Nothing to do here right now
strings.ui_feedback_staff_serving: A Cashier Assistant is serving this lane
strings.ui_feedback_burnt_discarded: The burnt tray went into the bin
strings.ui_recipe_expires: Best Before / Expires in: {hours} in-game hours
strings.ui_recipe_price_locked: Prices can be changed from Day 4.
strings.ui_skip_open_tip: Jump ahead to {time}, when the shop opens.
strings.ui_skip_open_confirm: Skip ahead to {time}? Time passes as usual, only faster: mixers and ovens keep working, hired bakers keep baking and bread keeps ageing. The skip stops early if an oven needs you.
strings.ui_skip_open_oven: Take the bread out of the oven first.
strings.ui_skip_open_stopped: Skip stopped: an oven needs you.
strings.ui_recipe_analytics_locked: Finish one batch to see analytics.
strings.ui_display_discard_confirm: Throw away the stale and expired bread? There is no refund.
strings.ui_market_delivery_note: Daytime orders arrive in 3 in-game hours.
strings.ui_market_after_hours_note: After closing, ingredients go straight into Storage.
strings.ui_market_locked: The Market opens after the Day 3 settlement.
strings.ui_equipment_slots_full: All slots are in use. Replace one?
strings.ui_upgrade_max: You own the finest bakery in town!
strings.ui_upgrade_blocked_display: Not enough display space would remain for your bread.
strings.ui_upgrade_blocked_jobs: Finish or clear every batch in the kitchen first.
strings.ui_staff_full: No free {role} slot at this location
strings.ui_staff_wage_warning: Your cash may not cover tomorrow's wages. Consider giving someone a day off.
strings.ui_staff_fire_confirm: Dismiss {name}? Today's wage is still paid.
strings.ui_marketing_busy: Only one campaign can run at a time.
strings.ui_marketing_confirm: Launch {campaign} for {cost}? There is no refund.
strings.ui_decor_hint: Tap a piece of furniture, then tap a tile to move it.
strings.ui_decor_invalid_zone: It does not belong in this area
strings.ui_decor_invalid_path: That would block the path for customers or staff
strings.ui_decor_invalid_access: It needs a free tile in front
strings.ui_decor_invalid_reserved: This tile is a walkway and must stay clear
strings.ui_decor_invalid_blocks_access: Another station needs this tile to be used
strings.ui_decor_legend_clear: Red striped tiles must stay clear so customers and staff can walk through.
strings.ui_decor_legend_zone: Grey dotted tiles are outside the area where this item belongs.
strings.ui_decor_warn_walkway: It would block the walkway customers and staff use.
strings.ui_decor_warn_access: It would block the tile needed to use another station.
strings.ui_decor_move_hint: Tap a free tile to move it, or tap it again when you are done.
strings.ui_decor_place_hint: Tap a free tile to place it.
strings.ui_decor_slots_full: {type} spots are full ({count}/{count}). Put one away, or upgrade the shop for more.
strings.ui_decor_slot_hint_wall: Tap a glowing spot on the wall to hang it.
strings.ui_decor_slot_hint_counter: Tap a glowing spot on a counter to put it there.
strings.ui_decor_slot_move: Tap another glowing spot to move it, or tap it again when you are done.
strings.ui_decor_pick_slot: Tap one of the glowing spots.
strings.ui_decor_rug_hint: Tap a floor tile in the shop to lay the rug. Rotate turns it.
strings.ui_decor_slot_usage_tip: Decorations in use at this shop. A bigger shop has more spots.
strings.ui_summary_no_stock_note: Storage is empty. Visit the Market before continuing.
strings.ui_settings_mute_unfocused: Mute when the game is in the background
strings.ui_help_replay_note: Replaying a tip never resets your progress.
strings.ui_tutorial_skip_confirm: Skip the tutorial? Days 1 to 3 still follow the opening schedule.
strings.tut_welcome: Welcome to your bakery. Let's bake your first loaf.
strings.tut_tap_storage: Tap Storage to choose a recipe.
strings.tut_choose_recipe: Choose a recipe and a batch size.
strings.tut_tap_mixer: Tap the Mixer to start mixing.
strings.tut_equipment_works: The equipment keeps working while you move around.
strings.tut_mixer_done: Mixing is done. Tap the Mixer again to pick up the dough.
strings.tut_to_oven: Take the dough to the Oven.
strings.tut_burn_risk: Take it out before it burns.
strings.tut_choose_slot: Choose a Display slot for the finished bread.
strings.tut_patience: Customers lose patience while they wait.
strings.tut_manual_cashier: Stand at the cashier to serve customers until you hire a Cashier Assistant.
strings.tut_income: Coins go into your cash as soon as the bread is paid for.
strings.tut_rotifood: RotiFood orders do not reserve stock until you pack them.
strings.tut_summary: This is your Daily Summary: income, costs, utilities, waste and ratings.
strings.tut_freshness: Bread ages on the display: Fresh, then Good, then Stale. Leftovers stay overnight until they expire.
strings.tut_day2_prep: A new day! Your ingredients are in Storage.
strings.tut_office_worker: Office workers are in a hurry. Serve them quickly!
strings.tut_queue_capacity: The queue has limited spots. When it is full, new customers wait outside.
strings.tut_pricing: Adjust the price here. Cheaper bread draws more customers; pricier bread draws fewer.
strings.tut_smart_speed: When bread is nearly ready, the game slows to normal speed so you can react.
strings.tut_fried_bread_stale: Fried bread goes stale quickly. Keep some batches for the afternoon.
strings.tut_day3_balance: Keep enough bread for both walk-in customers and RotiFood orders.
strings.tut_market_unlock: The Market is open from now on.
strings.tut_market_teaser: From tomorrow, you can order ingredients at any time. Daytime deliveries take 3 in-game hours.
strings.dlg_bailout_first: Hey there! I heard the bakery has been having a rough few days. Don't give up. The local government has a small-business support program for hardworking owners like you. Here is a little emergency capital to get you baking again. Keep going—your bread is worth it!
strings.dlg_bailout_repeat: Back again, kid? There's no shame in that. Here's a little more help, and a tip to go with it.
strings.dlg_bailout_solo: Your staff are taking a short break. You'll run the shop solo until cash is back.
strings.ui_table_dough_spoiled: The {recipe} dough on the holding table went bad and was thrown away.
strings.ui_table_bread_spoiled: The {recipe} on the holding table went bad and was thrown away.
strings.thought_quiet_1: Hmm... why hasn't anyone come in yet?
strings.thought_quiet_3: Is my shop really that unpopular? Maybe my bread isn't any good...
strings.thought_quiet_4: Maybe I should just take up catfish farming instead.
strings.mood_great: What a day! Your bread sold like hotcakes!
strings.mood_good: A good day. Keep it up!
strings.mood_even: Not bad. Try baking a little more tomorrow!
strings.mood_rough: A tough day. Don't give up!
strings.mood_bailout: Pak Lurah is on his way...
strings.hl_vip_visit: A food vlogger stopped by! Their review arrives tomorrow.
strings.hl_rain_surge: Heavy rain, and RotiFood boomed! +{percent}% online orders.
strings.hl_orders_cancelled: {count} RotiFood orders were cancelled. Watch your stock!
strings.hl_burnt_batches: {count} batches burned today. Keep an eye on the oven!
strings.hl_staff_star: {name} did amazing work today! Production x{multiplier}.
strings.hl_low_ingredients: Ingredients are running low! Don't forget the Market.
strings.hl_solo_day: You're running the shop solo today. You've got this!
strings.hl_holiday: Holiday weekend! The whole town is out shopping.
strings.tip_leftover: Try baking a little less tomorrow. Bake for the customers you expect.
strings.tip_cancelled_orders: Keep stock ready for RotiFood drivers too. They don't like waiting!
strings.tip_low_cash: Money's getting tight. Focus on Plain Fried Bread for now—it costs the least and earns the most for what you spend!
strings.tip_rating_drop: Fast service matters a lot for your rating. Hire a cashier so the queue keeps moving while you bake.
strings.tip_rain_tomorrow: Looks like rain tomorrow. Bake extra for the RotiFood rush!
strings.tip_first_day: Welcome, kid! Plain Fried Bread and Plain White Loaf are the cheapest to start with.
strings.tip_high_profit: Wonderful! Are you ready to upgrade your shop?
strings.tip_solo_mode: It's fine to work alone for a while. Every great business owner has been here!
strings.tip_holiday_soon: A holiday weekend is coming. Stock up, and maybe start a marketing campaign!
strings.tip_default: Every loaf you bake is a step forward. See you tomorrow!
strings.ui_overflow_body: Your fortune is now too large to count. The bakery keeps going, just for fun.
strings.ui_record_most_bread_sold_day: Most Bread Sold in One Day
strings.ui_record_most_customers_day: Most Customers Served in One Day
strings.ui_record_most_rotifood_day: Most RotiFood Orders Completed in One Day
strings.ach_no_burn_day_desc: Finish a day without a burnt batch.
strings.ach_week_no_burn_desc: Go 7 days in a row without a burnt batch.
strings.ach_queue_master_desc: Finish a day without any customer losing patience.
strings.ach_tier5_desc: Upgrade to the Mega Bakery Landmark.
strings.ach_all_recipes_desc: Produce every recipe at least once.
strings.ach_price_experiment_desc: Sell bread below 80% and above 125% of its reference price.
strings.ach_rain_delivery_desc: Complete 20 RotiFood orders on one rainy day.
strings.ach_solo_recovery_desc: Recover from a bailout and reach more than 5,000 KR.
strings.ach_big_day_desc: Earn more than 50,000 KR in one day.
strings.staff_special_queue: Customers in this lane stay calmer (−{percent}% impatience).
strings.staff_special_rating: Friendly service: every sale in this lane lifts your rating {percent}% more.
strings.staff_special_tip: A sweet smile: {percent}% chance of an extra tip.
strings.staff_cashier_budi: A diligent first-year student. He gets flustered counting change, but his smile is always genuine.
strings.staff_cashier_sari: The friendly girl next door who greets every customer like a Sunday-morning cartoon host.
strings.staff_cashier_dimas: Loves chatting about the weather so much that he sometimes forgets to press Confirm.
strings.staff_cashier_nadia: A former minimarket cashier who keeps every receipt neat and precise.
strings.staff_cashier_rian: Quick on his feet and always ready for the after-school rush.
strings.staff_cashier_lili: Calm and patient; waiting customers feel relaxed around her.
strings.staff_cashier_maya: A persuasive talker who can soothe even the most hurried office worker.
strings.staff_cashier_reza: His fingers dance across the register keys without a single mistake.
strings.staff_cashier_dewi: Remembers every regular's name and favorite bread.
strings.staff_cashier_hendra: A shopper-psychology expert whose warm chat sends every customer home smiling.
strings.staff_cashier_citra: Calm and composed, she can handle a queue of twenty without breaking a sweat.
strings.staff_cashier_kenji: Disciplined and courteous, famous for his polite bow and lightning speed.
strings.staff_cashier_grace: The "Ambassador of Smiles". Happy customers often leave her an extra tip.
strings.staff_cashier_tejo: A legendary 90s department-store cashier who can count change with his eyes closed.
strings.staff_cashier_luna: A local idol on a relaxed side job; the counter is always buzzing when she's around.
strings.staff_baker_joko: Can knead heavy dough for hours, but tends to daydream when the oven dings.
strings.staff_baker_ani: Always tastes the jam before spreading it, and loves learning new baking tricks.
strings.staff_baker_bagus: Grew up helping his mother fry snacks at home; always quick on his feet.
strings.staff_baker_fajar: Rolls croissant dough to a perfectly even thickness.
strings.staff_baker_rina: Weighs yeast and butter with great discipline; her dough rarely falls flat.
strings.staff_baker_doni: Never gives up, and always wipes the counter after whisking eggs.
strings.staff_baker_aris: The "Yeast King", a fermentation expert for soft loaves and crusty baguettes.
strings.staff_baker_tari: Graceful and nimble, known for fragrant cinnamon rolls and Danish pastries.
strings.staff_baker_gilang: A pull-apart bread specialist whose dough rises beautifully in any weather.
strings.staff_baker_sophie: A classically trained French baker who folds hundreds of buttery layers.
strings.staff_baker_danu: A healthy-artisan maestro of natural sourdough and whole grains.
strings.staff_baker_aoi: A perfectionist from Kyoto who stacks flawless matcha mille crepes.
strings.staff_baker_pierre: A world-class pastry maestro whose bread is as soft as a cloud.
strings.staff_baker_mawar: A grandmother with a secret family recipe book. Nothing ever burns in her hands.
strings.staff_baker_alistair: A modern culinary alchemist who turns truffle and artisan butter into the city's finest bread.
strings.campaign_flyer_t1_desc: Friendly flyers for neighbors and school kids. Great for Plain White Loaf and Sugar Donuts.
strings.campaign_street_banner_t2_desc: Banners at busy crossings bring more office workers in the morning rush. +0.08 stars per smooth day.
strings.campaign_radio_magazine_t3_desc: A radio jingle and a magazine review bring party hosts who buy in bulk. +0.15 stars per day.
strings.campaign_influencer_t4_desc: Food vloggers bring socialites, and critics visit more often. +0.30 stars per day.
strings.campaign_food_festival_t5_desc: The whole city comes to visit. Make sure your kitchen and cashiers can keep up! +0.50 stars per day.
